name: Overview
html:
The Rite in the Deer Park

The lights across the lake are a ritual. Hester Crayle, the Silverbrook midwife, and five villagers have carried a young woman in labour into the deer park. Her name is Edie Lamb. She is not Claudia Bay, and Hester is not the Clairvoyant, but the players do not know that until the fight is over. Five lamps hold the circle open. If the child is born under the open door, something comes through and takes it. The players must break the circle, kill Hester, and bring the mother and child through the night.

Episode Summary

Players3–6, Level 14
Duration~3 hours
PacingChase; Combat (Boss); Reveal
Scenes5
CastHester Crayle; Edie Lamb; the Lamp Keepers of Silverbrook
RewardTBD
ReferencesDoom Counter; Dread Insight; Birth Track; Ether Summons; Beastwood map; Mythos Cultist stat blocks

Timeline

Weeks ago. Hester Crayle, midwife to half of Silverbrook, took Edie Lamb on as her patient and told her the big house would see to her lying-in.

Days ago. Colonel Standard brought Claudia Bay to Claremonte Gardens. She and Edie were kept together in the Locked Room.

Yesterday. A dragonborn assassin killed Standard at the gala. The players took his Pale Journal and the gate key.

This evening. Claudia left for town in the closed carriage. Edie's labour began. The household carried her down to the deer park.

Ten o'clock. Hester lights the five lamps on the Moon Mound. Tonight.

Episode Structure

The episode starts at the second-floor window where Episode Nine ended. The players cross the lake, or go round it, and find the ritual in the deer park, a maze of glades called the Beastwood.

The fight on the Moon Mound is the episode. It runs against the Birth Track: one step a round. The players stop the ritual by putting out all five lamps or by killing Hester. If the track reaches six, the door opens and a Hunting Horror takes the child.

After the fight, the players deliver the baby. Then they find Hester's bag: the instructions for the rite in the Clairvoyant's hand, and Hester's report to a Mr. Connely. The woman on the mound is not Claudia. Claudia went to town this evening.

The Doom Counter

Start: equal to the party's number of Dread Insights.

Add 1 Doom each time a watcher sees the players, a handbell rings, or the players lose their way in the Beastwood.

Escalating Doom

MarkEscalation
3The watchers ring their handbell. The Lamp Keepers turn outward.
6Add 1 to the Birth Track.
9Ether Summons applies to every spell and curse cast within 60 ft. of the mound.
12The door tears open: the Birth Track moves to 5.

Manifesting Doom

CostDoom
1Mythos Disadvantage

5Activate one Dread Ability

name: Scenes 1-2: Across the Lake, The Beastwood
html:
Scene 1: Across the Lake

Claremonte Gardens, the lake shore. Night. ~15 min

A flight of steps runs down from the terrace to a boathouse on the water. The lake is black and still. On the far side, lights move among the trees.

What's Happening. The ritual began at ten. Set the Birth Track by how Episode Nine ended: 0 for total success, 1 for mixed, 2 for total failure.

The Boat. A rowing boat in the boathouse crosses the lake in a few minutes and lands at the Landing (W1). The water is open and the moon is up.

The Path. A gravel path runs round the east end of the lake and enters the deer park at the Lake Gap (W2). It is dark under the trees and no one watches it, but the walk is long: add 1 to the Birth Track.

Skill Checks

Stealth DC 16. Cross the lake unseen. On a failure, the Pike brothers see the boat from the South Hollow (W3): add 1 Doom.

Scene Flow. Once the players are ashore, move to the Beastwood map.

Scene 2: The Beastwood

The deer park. Night. ~30 min

Old oaks and thorn crowd together into walls, with grassy glades between them. A lantern hangs from a branch ahead, and another beyond it.

What's Happening. The household hung lanterns to mark the way from the Landing to the Moon Mound (W6). Two watchers, the Pike brothers, stand in the South Hollow (W3) with a handbell.

Lanterns. Following the lanterns leads straight to the clearing. Leaving them means finding a way through the glades.

Skill Checks

Survival DC 15. Cross the Beastwood off the lantern line without losing the way. On a failure, the players come out at the wrong glade: add 1 Doom and 1 to the Birth Track.

Perception DC 14. Hear the Pike brothers talking in the South Hollow before they see the players.

Scene Flow. When the players reach the edge of the east clearing, run Scene 3.

The Birth Track

The ritual's clock. It starts at 0, 1 or 2 (Scene 1). On initiative count 10 of every round, add 1.

0. The lamps are lit. Hester begins the words.

1. Edie's pains come close together.

2. The lamplight turns cold and white. The air over the mound ripples like heat.

3. Every lantern in the Beastwood goes out.

4. The door opens over the mound: a round hole of black sky with no stars. From now on, Ether Summons applies to every spell and curse cast within 60 ft. of the mound.

5. The child is coming.

6. The child is born under the open door. Run If the Door Opens.

Stopping the Track. The track stops when the last lamp goes out or when Hester dies. The door closes, and Edie's labour goes on without it.

Doom

Mythos Disadvantage. Disadvantage on one roll.

Murphy's Law. A branch snaps underfoot, a lantern swings into view, a boot sinks in mud.

Cut Off. A fallen bough or a deep pool blocks the way. The players must go around.

The Herd. The park's deer bolt through the glade. Each creature in a 30-ft.-wide line makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Failure: 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and Prone.

Enemy Reinforcements. A villager comes up the lantern line: an Awakened Cultist.

Activate one Dread Ability. Trigger a Dread Insight already held by a player.

name: The Beastwood (map key)
html:
The Beastwood

The Deer Park

Map: 10.01 in Foundry. One square is 2.5 ft.

W1. The Landing. A strip of trodden shore where the lake reaches into the park. The household's punt is drawn up on the mud.

W2. The Lake Gap. The path round the lake enters the wood here, by a stile in the park fence.

W3. The South Hollow. A low ring of earth. The Pike brothers, two Awakened Cultists, keep watch here with a handbell.

W4. The Lantern Walk. The glades north of the Landing. Lanterns hang from the branches every forty feet, leading east.

W5. The East Pool. Deep, cold water under the trees. Reeds at the edge.

W6. The Moon Mound. An oval mound in the east clearing, with the ritual on top: Edie on a pallet, Hester Crayle beside her, and five Lamp Keepers at five lamps on poles around the mound. The cart stands at the west edge of the clearing, with two Corrupted Cultists, the carters.

W7. The Hart's Hollow. A ring of earth in the north glades. The deer herd shelters here.

W8. The Twin Pools. Two small pools in the far north-west.

W9. The Old Mound. A low ring of earth in the northern glade. Empty.

Running the Beastwood

The tree stands are terrain walls: they block movement, and a creature can see through the edge of one stand but not past it into the next glade. The glades are open ground.

Who Is Where

WhereWho
South Hollow (W3)Awakened Cultist x2
Cart (W6)Corrupted Cultist x2
Lamps (W6)Lamp Keeper x5
Mound (W6)Hester Crayle, Edie Lamb

The Cultists

Killing one sets off its death curse.

TypeDeath curse

Hester CrayleTormenting Pox; the door closes

name: Scene 3: The Moon Mound
html:
Scene 3: The Moon Mound

The east clearing (W6). Night. ~60 min

An oval mound rises in the middle of the clearing. Five lamps on poles stand in a ring around it, and a woman lies on a pallet on top, under a blanket.

What's Happening. Hester kneels at Edie's head and speaks the words. The Lamp Keepers face inward and chant with her. The carters wait by the cart. Edie is in labour and cannot move, run or fight.

Who the Players See. From the edge of the clearing, the woman on the mound is a pregnant woman with dark hair. Do not say whether she is Claudia. Hester's back is to them.

Roll Initiative. Hester is an Epic Boss: she acts on initiative count 10 and takes Responses after each player's turn. Add 1 to the Birth Track on count 10 each round.

The Lamps. Each Lamp Keeper holds one lamp on a pole. A lamp goes out when its Keeper dies, or when a creature within 5 ft. of it uses an action to put it out. A lamp cannot be lit again tonight.

Hester's Ward. While two or more lamps burn, Hester has resistance to all damage.

Edie. Area spells and curses that cover the mound cover Edie. She has 9 HP and AC 10. At 0 HP she is dying and makes death saving throws; if she lives, the Birth (Scene 4) is made at Disadvantage.

If the Door Opens

At 6 on the Birth Track, the child is born. A Hunting Horror comes down through the door, takes the child in its coils, and rises. It acts on the next initiative count 10. If it has taken 100 or more damage by then, it drops the child on the mound and fights. Otherwise it carries the child up through the door, and the door closes behind it.

name: Scenes 4-5 and Resolution
html:
Scene 4: The Birth

The Moon Mound. Night. ~15 min

The lamps are out. The clearing is dark except for the moon, and Edie is crying for help.

What's Happening. The ritual is broken but the labour is not over. Edie needs someone to deliver her child.

Skill Checks

Medicine DC 15. One player delivers the child. Other players can help, giving Advantage.

  • Success. A boy, small and loud. Mother and child are well.
  • Failure. The child is well. Edie bleeds badly and lives only if the players get her to Silverbrook tonight.

Scene 5: The Bag

The Moon Mound. Night. ~15 min

Hester's midwife's bag lies open by the pallet: scissors, twine, clean cloths, a bottle of brandy, and a bundle of folded papers.

What's Happening. The papers are the two handouts: The Proving, in a hand that is not Hester's, and Hester's unfinished Report to Mr. Connely.

The Reveal. The woman on the mound is Edie Lamb, a dairymaid from Silverbrook. She is not Claudia. Edie knows Claudia: "Mrs. Bay. They kept us together in the cellar. They took her away in the carriage at dusk."

Skill Checks

Investigation DC 14. The Proving was written by an educated hand, with a good pen, by someone used to giving orders. It is not the hand of anyone the players have met.

Resolution

Outcome Ladder.

  • Total success. The track stopped before 4. Mother and child are well.
  • Mixed. The door opened, but the players kept the child.
  • Total failure. The Hunting Horror carried the child through the door.

Rewards. TBD.

Threads and Dead Ends.

  • Claudia. Gone to town tonight in the closed carriage.
  • Mr. Connely. The report was for him. Nothing says who he is.
  • The Proving. "For ours" means another child. The players can guess whose.
  • Hester's villagers. Dead or gone. Silverbrook will have questions in the morning.

name: Handouts
html:
Handouts

The Proving

Found in Hester Crayle's bag. Two sheets of good paper, folded in four, in a neat, sloping hand.

The Proving.

Take the girl down to the deer park when she is near her time. Begin at ten, when the moon is over the trees.

Five lamps on the five points, each kept by one of your own. Let none of them go out.

Lay her on the old mound, inside the lamps, head to the north.

When her pains come close together, speak the words on the second leaf, and do not stop.

The child must come out under the open door. Hold it up. What comes through will take it.

Write down everything: the hour, the moon, how long the door stays open, what comes.

If the door opens for this one, it will open for ours.

Send your account by the morning coach.

Report to Mr. Connely

Found in Hester Crayle's bag. A single sheet in a cramped, careful hand, unfinished.

Mr. Connely,

As instructed. The Colonel's woman went up to town this evening in the closed carriage, with two of the house men. She was well.

The Lamb girl's pains began at four. We go down to the park at nine. Lamps, linen and the cart are ready, and five of ours to keep the lamps.

The Colonel did not come back from town. The household is uneasy. I have told them it makes no difference.

The door

name: Cast and Horrors
html:
Cast

Hester Crayle

Midwife of Silverbrook. Leader of the rite.

Description: Sixty, small and strong, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a midwife's bag at her knee.

Mannerisms: Talks to Edie as she has talked to every mother for forty years: low, steady, never hurried.

Intent: Bring the child out under the open door and write down what comes for it.

Edie Lamb

Dairymaid of Hollow Farm, Silverbrook. Nineteen.

Description: Dark hair stuck to her face, a borrowed nightgown, a wedding ring on a string round her neck.

Mannerisms: Grips the nearest hand and will not let go. Asks for her husband, Tom, a gunner on the harbour batteries.

Intent: Live, and keep her child. Trusted Hester until tonight.

The Lamp Keepers

Five villagers of Silverbrook, sworn to the cult.

Description: Amos Wick, the chandler; Nan Tallow, his sister; Gideon Hookes, the reeve; Prue Mutter, the sexton's wife; Will Shank, the carter's boy. Each holds a lamp on a pole.

Mannerisms: Chant with Hester and keep their eyes on the mound.

Intent: Keep the lamps burning. None of them leaves the ring.

The Pike Brothers

Awakened Cultists. The South Hollow (W3).

Description: Two farmhands in dark smocks, one with a brass handbell.

Mannerisms: Argue in whispers about whether the big house will pay them.

Intent: Ring the bell if anyone comes up from the lake.

Horrors

Hester Crayle, Epic Boss

Large aberration (cultist), CR 15.

AC 22; HP 420; Speed 30 ft. Acts on Init 10. Many Hands +16, reach 15 ft., 39 (6d10 + 6) necrotic, Grappled and pulled 10 ft. Lullaby (recharge 5-6) 60 ft., DC 19 Cha, 78 (12d12) psychic, Incapacitated and a Tormenting Nox. The Moon's Door (recharge 6) DC 19 Con, 60-ft. radius, 39 necrotic, pushed 15 ft., Birth Track +1. Resists all damage while two lamps burn.

Description: Her arms have split into many long, pale hands, all reaching.

Intent: Keep the players off the mound until the child comes.

Lamp Keeper

Medium humanoid (cultist), CR 9.

AC 15; HP 60; Speed 30 ft. Lamp Pole +11, reach 10 ft., 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning, pushed 10 ft. Moonlamp Flare (recharge 5-6) 45-ft. cone, DC 16 Cha, 34 (6d8 + 7) psychic and Blinded. Spiteful Curse (reaction) DC 16 Con or a Rotting Pox. Death: its lamp goes out; its killer saves DC 16 Cha or gains a Tormenting Nox.

Intent: Hold its place in the ring.

Returning Horrors

Stat blocks from Episode Nine, in Foundry.

Awakened Cultist. CR 5, AC 12, HP 24. Dagger +10, Pox Curse DC 15.

Corrupted Cultist. CR 6, AC 13, HP 40. Rises on Init 20 as an Awakened Aberration (CR 11, AC 17, HP 150).

Hunting Horror. Huge, CR 17, AC 19, HP 312. Comes through only if the Birth Track reaches 6.
